subtitle: Lesson 30 · Monitoring & Alerting Automation

code:
$metrics = [PSCustomObject]@{
    CollectedAt = Get-Date
    SqlInstance = 'SQLPRD01'
    CpuPercent  = (Get-DbaCpuUsage -SqlInstance SQLPRD01).PercentCpuUsage
    FreeDiskPct = (Get-DbaDiskSpace -SqlInstance SQLPRD01 |
                   Select-Object -First 1).PercentFree
}

$metrics | Export-Csv -Path '\\fileshare\metrics\sqlprd01.csv' `
  -Append -NoTypeInformation
caption: Each scheduled run appends a row — a real time series over time.

code:
# PowerShell's job: collect and write the metric row
# Power BI / Grafana's job: read that source and render the chart

# Power BI  -> connects to CSV, folder, or SQL Server table
# Grafana   -> built around time-series data sources
caption: The script's job stops at writing data; the dashboard tool renders it.
